window-1.title: ssh.place — Timelapses
window-1.blurb: Watch a whole day of strangers quietly fighting and collaborating over one 200×60 pixel canvas replay as a GIF — it's a tiny communal folk-art archive made entirely in a terminal, and I think you'll want to go claim a corner of it.

window-2.title: Cool but not “cool cool” — Kiko Mizuhara on Blackbird Spyplane
window-2.blurb: Spyplane at its goofiest and most obsessive, interviewing a Tokyo shapeshifter who acts, models, and designs — basically your side-quest energy in interview form.

window-3.title: Shirley Temple (with real grenadine)
window-3.blurb: The most gloriously kitsch drink ever invented, made with actual pomegranate grenadine instead of the radioactive stuff — pure diner-counter nostalgia that deserves a flash photo and three cherries.

window-4.title: The Selby — Inside Creative People's Homes
window-4.blurb: It's basically permission to let your rooms look like your brain — every shelf, taped photo and inherited lamp doing the decorating for you.

window-5.title: Dona Manis Heritage Bakehouse, Katong
window-5.blurb: The 30-year-old basement banana pie legend finally got a sit-down room in Katong — and it doubles as a stop on a city-wide Monopoly heritage trail, so your pastry run comes with a built-in side quest.
